messages:
morgan: quick sync — pushing Optimize toolkit quant recs into canary tonight. Need a couple quick confirmations so we don't block rollout. TL;DR: approvals by 17:00 PT please.

morgan: checklist: 1) @sasha — approve quant profile (proposed: `int8_fast` w/ per-layer fallback) for gpt-3-small variant. 2) @aditya — confirm KV-cache enabled on staging + report p50/p99 after batch-size tweak. 3) @claire — rerank integration tests green for long-contexts (8k+). 4) call out any regression alerts you saw in last 24h.

sasha: on it. quick q — did the perf sweep include the embedding/reauthor pipeline? the quant PR note mentions only generation flows. :eyes:

aditya: KV cache is enabled on staging but I saw p99 climb under synthetic burst at batch_size=64. I can run a sweep across batch_size=[16,32,48] and report. if we need lower latency, we might cap at 32. will start now, expect results in ~40m.

claire: rerank tests are failing on one long-context case (threaded-docs). stack: `IndexError` inside token-windowing when context > 8192. I'm bisecting, probable off-by-one in the chunker. I'll open a small PR to guard and add test. ETA 3pm.

morgan: thanks. sasha — embedding pipeline was included for the regression harness (link: https://internal.redwood.ai/optkit/reports/3687). but double-check the commit selector (it was scoped to master vs canary).

sasha: saw the report — embeddings latency didn't regress, generation p50 improved, p99 unchanged. leaving a note on the report with +quant results. approving `int8_fast` once aditya confirms staging p99 is within SLO. :white_check_mark:

aditya: perf sweep results: batch=16 p99=180ms, batch=32 p99=210ms, batch=48 p99=290ms. memory footprint acceptable at 32. recommending batch_size=32 for canary, and enable prefix-KV cache TTL=60s. uploading trace + flamegraphs to the report.

claire: pushed test fix PR -> #4523, added regression test for 12k context too. CI shows flaky on rerank_e2e, rerunning.

morgan: plan: set canary to use quant_profile=`int8_fast`, batching.max_tokens=512, batch_size=32, KV-cache TTL=60s. roll window 30m, observability hooks on token-level latency and rerank-quality metric. if no critical regressions by 23:30 PT, promote.

morgan: final asks: aditya please attach the perf artifacts to the canary ticket; sasha drop a short approval message in the PR; claire ping when CI goes green.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-17T23:00:00Z for rollout/optimize-toolkit-canary. Monitor: /ops/optkit/canary-3687654321.

claire: CI green now, merged PR #4523. all good from rerank side. :shipit:

sasha: approval left on PR, added note about fallback thresholds.

aditya: artifacts uploaded to the ticket. leaving a follow-up to test batch=24 because of memory headroom, but proceed with batch=32 for canary.

morgan: great — thanks everyone. I'll watch the canary and call it in 30m if stable. :thumbsup:
